_why: AXIOM's public surface is the MCP tool registry and the closed error-code enum. A tool added in packages/mcp/src/tools.ts that never reaches docs/reference/mcp-tools.md, the package README or spec/tools.json is invisible to every integrator; an error code added in schema/src/errors.ts without re-emitting packages/schema/schemas/*.json ships a stale JSON Schema. scripts/check-tool-parity.mjs and scripts/check-schema-json-fresh.mjs are the hard gates; this file is the early reminder while editing.
